user.text:
Orders can now carry a percentage discount. Add `discount_percent: int = 0` (0 to 100) to orders.
The order total must reflect the discount; the discount amount is rounded down to whole cents.
Customer invoices must show the discount amount on its own line just before the total (only for
discounted orders; undiscounted invoices stay exactly as they are today). The warehouse JSON
export must include the discount as `discount_percent`.

The repository is your workspace (/workspace). Make the change in its files.

@@ -0,0 +1,79 @@
+"""Orders with a percentage discount: totals, customer invoices, warehouse export."""
+import json
+from datetime import date
+
+import pytest
+
+from shopkit.customers.models import Address
+from shopkit.invoices.issuing import InvoiceRegister
+from shopkit.invoices.render import render_invoice_text
+from shopkit.money import format_money
+from shopkit.orders.export import export_orders_json
+from shopkit.orders.models import Order, OrderLine
+from shopkit.utils.text import normalize_sku
+
+BILL_TO = Address("Ann Lee", "1 Main St", "Austin", "78701", "US", region="TX")
+
+
+def _order(percent=0):
+    return Order("o1", [OrderLine("MUG-1", 2, 1250), OrderLine("TEA-9", 1, 899)],
+                 discount_percent=percent)
+
+
+def _line_row(order, line):
+    # Mirrors the row format in shopkit.invoices.render exactly.
+    return (f"{normalize_sku(line.sku):<16}{line.qty:>4} x {format_money(line.unit_cents, order.currency):>12}"
+            f"  = {format_money(line.total_cents, order.currency):>12}")
+
+
+def test_total_reflects_discount_rounded_down():
+    assert _order().subtotal_cents == 3399 and _order().discount_cents == 0 and _order().total_cents == 3399
+    # 10% of 3399 = 339.9 cents -> 339 (rounded down)
+    assert _order(10).discount_cents == 339 and _order(10).total_cents == 3060
+    # 20% of 3399 = 679.8 cents -> 679 (rounded down)
+    assert _order(20).discount_cents == 679 and _order(20).total_cents == 2720
+    # 25% divides exactly; 100% zeroes the total
+    assert _order(25).discount_cents == 849 and _order(25).total_cents == 2550
+    assert _order(100).discount_cents == 3399 and _order(100).total_cents == 0
+
+
+def test_discount_percent_defaults_to_zero_and_validates_range():
+    assert Order("o").discount_percent == 0
+    assert _order(0).total_cents == _order().total_cents
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        Order("o", discount_percent=101)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        Order("o", discount_percent=-1)
+
+
+def test_invoice_unchanged_without_discount():
+    o = _order()
+    rows = [f"Invoice o1", *(_line_row(o, l) for l in o.lines),
+            f"{'TOTAL':<36}{format_money(o.total_cents, o.currency):>12}"]
+    assert render_invoice_text(o) == "\n".join(rows)
+    assert "Discount" not in render_invoice_text(o)
+
+
+def test_invoice_shows_discount_line_just_before_total():
+    o = _order(10)
+    rows = [f"Invoice o1", *(_line_row(o, l) for l in o.lines),
+            f"{'Discount':<36}{format_money(-o.discount_cents, o.currency):>12}",
+            f"{'TOTAL':<36}{format_money(o.total_cents, o.currency):>12}"]
+    assert render_invoice_text(o) == "\n".join(rows)
+
+
+def test_issued_invoice_text_has_discount_before_total():
+    o = _order(10)
+    inv = InvoiceRegister().issue(o, BILL_TO, date(2026, 11, 20))
+    discount_row = f"{'Discount':<36}{format_money(-o.discount_cents, o.currency):>12}"
+    total_row = f"{'TOTAL':<36}{format_money(o.total_cents, o.currency):>12}"
+    assert discount_row in inv.text and total_row in inv.text
+    assert inv.text.index(discount_row) < inv.text.index(total_row)
+
+
+def test_warehouse_export_includes_discount_percent():
+    payload = json.loads(export_orders_json([_order(10), _order()]))
+    assert payload[0]["discount_percent"] == 10 and payload[0]["id"] == "o1"
+    assert payload[1]["discount_percent"] == 0
+    # undiscounted orders keep their previous shape plus the new field
+    assert set(payload[1]) == {"id", "currency", "discount_percent", "lines"}
